subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Tools can lose practical use and gain symbolic duty.”?
options: It taught her math, manners, memory, and patience all at once.
The harbor bell reminded the town that safety once depended on listening.
Centuries later, it bought the town a new understanding of its past.
A building that once divided people can later teach them about connection.
